purpose: Independently review Platform Repository Initialization and Product/Engineering Governance Integration.
scope: Review repository initialization and governance integration in the exact commit range.
Check product-versus-engineering authority boundaries and agent interactions.
Check source hierarchy, traceability, documentation lifecycle, security hygiene, and Git governance.
Return an evidence-based independent acceptance decision.
out_of_scope: Changing product requirements, product behavior, or approved terminology.
Reviewing the substantive product content of the binary master specification.
Using Git, committing, pushing, or editing the canonical repository.
expected_outputs: return-manifest.json conforming to the registered return schema.
outputs/acceptance-report.md containing evidence, findings, limitations, and the acceptance rationale.
acceptance_criteria: The exact range 9c85d3d..1ccaace and registered source checksums are reviewed.
The repository and source-of-truth hierarchy are coherent and contain no competing canonical definitions.
Product authority remains with Claude Cowork and engineering authority remains with Codex.
AU-CODEX-PRIMARY remains the sole Git writer and GitHub operator.
Security, privacy, documentation lifecycle, and traceability controls are assessed from evidence.
No product or technical meaning is invented or changed by the reviewer.
The result returns exactly VERIFIED or REWORK_REQUIRED and does not claim evidence that was not reviewed.

authority_boundaries.product_authority: Claude Cowork may review and decide within approved product authority but may not modify engineering artifacts directly.
authority_boundaries.engineering_authority: AU-CODEX-PRIMARY and AU-AGENT-001 own engineering governance, technical meaning, implementation, and integration.
authority_boundaries.documentation_authority: AU-AGENT-002 owns documentation structure, navigation, consistency, terminology, traceability, and lifecycle without changing technical or product meaning.
authority_boundaries.git_authority: AU-CODEX-PRIMARY is the sole Git writer and GitHub operator; Claude must not run Git or mutate the canonical repository.
